freelancingStores.subject: Shopify improvements for {{store_name}}
freelancingStores.body:
Hi {{store_name}} Team,

I came across your store and noticed a few opportunities to improve its performance, user experience, and overall shopping journey.

I'm a freelance Shopify developer specializing in custom theme development, store improvements, speed optimization, and conversion-focused enhancements.

I'd love to share a few ideas tailored to your store and help you implement improvements that make sense for your business.

Would you be open to a quick conversation?

Portfolio: https://himansusoni-lilac.vercel.app/

Best regards,
Himanshu Soni
Freelance Shopify Developer | Performance, UX & CRO

appDevelopers.subject: Extra Shopify app development capacity for {{app_name}}
appDevelopers.body:
Hi {{app_name}} team,

I am a Shopify-focused full-stack developer and can help clear development backlogs across Remix, React, GraphQL, Shopify Admin APIs, and Admin UI extensions.

I have delivered 50+ custom Shopify stores and am comfortable joining an existing codebase, following its conventions, and taking a scoped item through implementation and review.

If there is a queued feature, extension, or integration that needs extra capacity, I would be glad to compare notes and see where I can help.

Best,
Himanshu
Full-Stack Shopify Developer

agencies.subject: White-label Shopify development support for {{agency_name}}
agencies.body:
Hello {{agency_name}} team,

I provide reliable white-label Shopify development support for agencies when client timelines exceed in-house capacity. I strictly adhere to your Figma-to-Liquid specifications, including layout, responsive behavior, design details, and interactions, and I raise questions early to avoid rework.

My work includes custom Liquid sections, Shopify theme builds, React, Remix, GraphQL, Node.js, and Shopify Admin APIs. I have delivered 50+ custom Shopify stores and can take on clearly scoped overflow work while keeping communication and delivery aligned with your agency.

If you have upcoming overflow work, I would be happy to discuss how I can support your team.

Best regards,
Himanshu
Full Stack Shopify Developer
